title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. I work in a Govt. Arms and Ammunition manufacturing unit under Ministry of Defence. A system called 'Outgoing Circular' is effective in our organisation in which a person or a group of people apply for outgoing facility for events like Diwali, Ganesh jayanti, Ambedkar jayanti, Ramdhan any many more events where they go out of the factory getting one time punching exemption and not to return for the day under the pretext of doing welfare work . In turn they get their Overtime booked for the whole day and get the pay accodingly. This type of facility is also availed by our muslim brethren in the holy month of Ramadhan. I want to ask whether taking this facility is jayaz as the overtime pay is granted if the person works in the factory beyond 8 hours of normal working. Please reply my query. May Allah give us all hidayat. 2663 views Q. I am on a project work to Belgium with my wife; she is pregnant now (5 weeks). 2242 views Q. Is lottery money halah or haram? 4475 views Q. Can i use credit card in hard times instead of asking others to help for money (kharz e hasana). 9692 views Q. Is it permitted in Islam to make sculptures? 2314 views Q. Is it allowed to clean ones ear with a qutip/bud? 6599 views Q. Do the breast feeding of wife is allowed in islam? 4440 views Q. I am a Software Engineer and selected in Oracle financial services company. I have heard that they are generally developing software products for Banking Domain. So is it ok to work there or I should not work there. Please suggest. 5168 views Q. Here in the UK, there are many 'theme parks' where there are many rides etc. Sometimes, Muslim Brothers/Muslim Sisters or even Muslim families go to these theme parks, especially during the summer to go for fun etc. My question is, is it permissable to go to these theme parks? The obvious thing is that there are men and women there, but here many Muslim families go regardless of the fact that there are both men and wmoen there. I would appreciate it if you could let us all know, so insha'Allah we can all have a clear message and pass it on to others. 3352 views Q. Is it Halal to spend interest earnings in paying of bank charges, like internet banking charges and ATM card charges etc. Please guide. 5588 views Q. I have a credit card and I pay outstanding amount before incurring any interest by bank. Bank offers discount of 3% on every transaction done through Credit card. For example if I have a transaction of AED 100 on credit card then I have to pay AED 97 before due date. Please advise whether discount of AED 3 offered by Bank is Hallal? 4581 views Q. I had applied passport for my wife long back. I got transfer to Hyderabad and my family came with me.We contacted verification officer at police station that my wife won't be there during verification. He told me to submit all required documents and also demanded Rs 5000/- ,since they will take of my wife's absence during verification. I paid Rs 2500/- to the officer and verification was done successfully. Please let me know whether I can pay interest amount to pay this amount. 1645 views Q. I have a question which a friend of mine told me. answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 35102 Country: India Title: Is it okay to shave the leg of a man who is involved in intensive sports activities Question: Is it okay to shave the leg of a man who is involved in intensive sports activities? Kindly answer as soon as possible? Your cooperation in this regard shall highly be appreciated. Answer ID: 35102 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1692/1161/L=1432) There is no harm in shaving the hair of leg. However it is necessary to observe Shariah limits while participating in sport activities. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
